reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual second-round review of external-02 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 09 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution returned-note crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

remaining_reasons: The return adds a distinct dark horizontal line/slot above the two gray-mark rows. The source has no such extra top line, and this round explicitly requires exactly two rows without an added upper horizontal. Remove that line while retaining the two compact source-scale gray-mark rows.
entries.positive_observation: Below the added line there are exactly two upper gray-mark rows with two groups per row and largely blank lower paper. The yellow mascot retains the image-right three-quarter pose and gaze, slightly parted lips with a small pale tooth edge, dark eyebrows, short dark sideburns and one short dark upper-lip moustache without a beard or glasses. The dark olive cap retains gold piping/cord and two separated front emblems. The dark high-collared uniform and one pale-edged dark throat cross remain. The rounded chin meets a short broad collar. The complete dark tilted frame, opaque warm grey-olive backing, cream note and right-edge tab remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The extra upper horizontal line is the remaining rejection reason.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine cap embroidery, collar-cross detail, moustache/mouth pixels and note lettering are extremely small at source scale. These uncertainties are not rejection reasons; the added dark horizontal line above the two rows is clearly visible in the native crop.
